outcome: Surgical site infection (SSI) rate following cesarean sections
cohort: The study participants were patients undergoing cesarean sections at Remera Rukoma Hospital in Rwanda.
finding: The project successfully reduced the average cesarean section infection rate from 2.025% (July-December 2023) to 0.45% (January-June 2024).
mod_finding: The project focused specifically on reducing surgical site infections following cesarean sections, a particular mode of birth.
